passages.text: The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto, included elsewhere in this Annual Report, as well as the information presented under “Presentation of Financial and Other Information.” The following discussion and analysis includes forward-looking statements. These forward-looking statements are subject to risks, uncertainties and other factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied by the forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to these differences include, but are not limited to, those discussed elsewhere in this Annual Report. See “Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” and “Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors.” For discussion related to the results of operations and changes in financial condition for the fiscal years 2024 compared to 2023 refer to “Item 5. Operating and Financial Review and Prospects” in our Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC and available electronically at www.sec.gov. A. Operating Results Overview Amer Sports is a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Atomic and Peak Performance. Our brands are known for their detailed craftsmanship, unwavering authenticity, premium market positioning and compelling market shares in their categories. We pride ourselves on cutting-edge innovation, technical performance and ground-breaking designs that allow athletes and everyday consumers to perform better every day. Through partnerships with industry influencers and elite athletes, and in collaboration with the various communities we serve, we develop next-generation products that define winning moments in sports. Our brands are creators of exceptional apparel, footwear, equipment, protective gear and accessories that we believe give our consumers the confidence and comfort to excel. Our brands are our stars, constantly elevating the consumer experience and creating thriving communities. We empower our brands to pursue market-shaping leadership and set the standard for quality, performance and brand experience globally. While our brands have established heritage and market leadership today, significant runway remains ahead. We are excited about our future and the opportunity to drive growth in each of our three reportable segments: Technical Apparel, Outdoor Performance and Ball & Racquet Sports. Our segments comprise our “brand clusters,” which reflect both how our consumers engage with our products and how we manage our business. Each segment is led by one of our core brands: Arc’teryx, Salomon and Wilson. Arc’teryx is a technical outdoor apparel brand inspired by the Canadian Coast Mountains and built on the principle of obsessive, precise design and production. Arc’teryx gear pushes the boundaries of performance and enables adventurers to excel in their outdoor pursuits in the mountains, in the backcountry and on some of the world’s most technical climbs. credit_strengths.text: Gross leverage fell sharply year on year and now sits well below the sector median, reflecting the debt paydown funded by the prior year's refinancing and strong earnings growth. The balance sheet carries modest borrowings relative to the EBITDA proxy, leaving substantial headroom to the next risk-band boundary.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure with a wide margin, and free cash flow to debt is far above the sector median and improved markedly year on year. This conversion supports internal funding of brand investment and modest bolt-on acquisitions without incremental borrowing.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows the senior secured notes maturing in the middle of the next decade, with only the other borrowings due in the coming year; refinancing is therefore concentrated in a single bullet. A repricing or refinancing of that note in a higher-rate environment would lift interest cost on the largest liability.

The MD&A flags forward-looking risk factors including brand, consumer demand and foreign exchange exposures across the premium apparel and outdoor portfolio. Operating margin, while improving year on year, remains below the sector median, so a demand or cost shock would compress the earnings base that supports coverage.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved sharply year on year and is close to the sector median, while EBITDA coverage sits above the peer median. Cash interest is comfortably absorbed by operating income, and the indicative financial risk profile is minimal on both leverage and cash-flow measures.

Cash and equivalents cover a large share of gross borrowings, leaving net debt modest and net leverage far below the sector median and the next threshold. Liquidity is further supported by a current ratio above the peer median, though the revolver is undrawn and provides contingent rather than drawn support.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a strong investment-grade-style profile: leverage below the sector median, coverage near peer levels and free cash flow to debt well above peers. Deleveraging from the prior refinancing is evident, and the indicative risk profile is minimal, though this is an analyst judgement rather than a rating.

Forward view: continued operating cash generation should fund capital expenditure and small acquisitions while the note remains outstanding. Key sensitivities are premium consumer demand, foreign exchange and the eventual refinancing of the bullet note; shareholder distribution data is unavailable, so cash-flow absorption by returns remains unknown.

credit_strengths.text: 總槓桿按年大幅下降，現時遠低於行業中位數，反映上年度再融資所得資金償還債務及盈利強勁增長。相對於EBITDA代理指標，資產負債表借款規模適中，距下一個風險區間界線仍有相當緩衝。
經營現金流覆蓋資本開支的幅度寬裕，自由現金流對債務比率遠高於行業中位數，並按年顯著改善。此現金轉換能力支持以內部資金投入品牌投資及小型補強式收購，而無需新增借款。

key_risks.text: 債務附註顯示，優先有擔保票據於下一個十年中期到期，來年僅有其他借款到期；因此再融資集中於單一子彈式到期。若該票據於利率較高環境下重新定價或再融資，將推高最大負債項目的利息成本。
管理層討論與分析列示前瞻性風險因素，包括品牌、消費者需求及外匯風險，涵蓋高端服飾及戶外產品組合。經營利潤率雖按年改善，仍低於行業中位數，故需求或成本衝擊將壓縮支撐覆蓋率的盈利基礎。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年大幅改善，接近行業中位數，而EBITDA覆蓋率則高於同業中位數。現金利息由經營溢利穩健吸收，指示性財務風險狀況在槓桿及現金流兩項指標上均為極低。
現金及等價物覆蓋總借款的相當比例，淨債務適中，淨槓桿遠低於行業中位數及下一個門檻。流動性進一步由高於同業中位數的流動比率支持，惟循環信貸額度尚未提取，提供的是或有而非已提取的支持。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈現強勁的投資級別式狀況：槓桿低於行業中位數，覆蓋率接近同業水平，自由現金流對債務比率遠高於同業。上年度再融資帶來的去槓桿明顯，指示性風險狀況為極低，惟此乃分析師判斷而非評級。
前瞻觀點：持續的經營現金產生應可支持資本開支及小型收購，而該票據仍未到期。主要敏感因素為高端消費者需求、外匯及該子彈式票據的最終再融資；股東分派數據不可得，故股東回報對現金流的吸納情況仍屬未知。
